nodes.label: Self-Keep-Alive Rationale (HF Free-Tier Sleep)
nodes.rationale: Free HF Spaces pause after inactivity, which shows up as downtime, so the bot pings its own public /health URL every 240s (below the host's 15-minute sleep timer) while an external UptimeRobot monitor covers cold starts, since the self-ping cannot fire while the container is asleep. On VPS/Docker the ping is unnecessary, so .env.example ships KEEP_ALIVE_ENABLED=false.

nodes.label: Session File Peer-Cache Persistence
nodes.rationale: The .session file stores Telegram peer access hashes, so deleting it makes log sends fail with [403 PEER_ID_INVALID] until each peer re-resolves; run.sh keeps sessions by default and warm_up_peer()/flush() re-resolve on PeerIdInvalid instead of requiring an admin message.

nodes.label: Background-Thread Web Server Startup
nodes.rationale: The Flask server is started in a background thread from features/bot.py so the health endpoint never blocks the Pyroblack event loop, and the port is configurable via the PORT env var.

nodes.label: Redis/DB Persistence for Deletion Records
nodes.rationale: Recommended fixes for the auto-delete subsystem: persist deletion records outside memory, guard with asyncio.Lock, retry failed deletions, log persistently, standardize on timezone-aware datetimes, add retention config, clean up stale records, alert on failures, and consider a queue for scalability.

nodes.label: Tiered File Delivery and Auto-Deletion
nodes.rationale: Delivered media is not hosted by the bot, so retention is tier-based (free vs premium minutes, with a lead-time warning DM) and persisted to file_deletions.json; orphan pruning is the primary deletion-detection mechanism because real-time channel deletions never reach bots via the Telegram API.

nodes.label: tzinfo UTC Normalization Guard
nodes.rationale: Legacy records were stored naive while new code uses datetime.now(timezone.utc); arithmetic between them raises TypeError, so naive values are re-tagged as UTC at runtime (no data migration) at five call sites in features/statistics.py. Prevention rule: always store timezone-aware datetimes and check tzinfo before arithmetic.
